reason: The printed page (the composite skeleton) sets the SW CLOSE format as the batch drew it, the italic SW module mark at its left: the REEL/UNIT brace and the WITH NO REWIND/LOCK brace inside one bracket, inside the file-name-1 brace, then the ellipsis. Drawn in the house style (figure_reading.restyle). The italic module mark is set as plain text (a figure carries no markup but <u>; the batch's <i> tag, escaped, rendered as literal text), padded to the width the drawing gave it, so this is the batch's drawing with that one change.
